skills.delivery_notes: Erratic wandering-path physical-magic projectile. Physical rule: element-neutral (magic damage component is element-neutral per MW1-close d2 magic-damage = element-NEUTRAL ruling). Path is semi-random wander — R-M6 drift-tick class; circle/zone token with drift note.

Persistent cold damage-per-second aura centered on caster body. 'main crowd control and cold damage dealer' — chill attested via cold-slow effect on enemies (movement crowd control via cold aura). Water family (cold register).
Elemental damage absorption shield (defensive self-buff; elemental damage absorbed).
Spirit that grants life bonus to player and party; free-toggle persistent buff (no reservation noted).

mapping_json.motion_frame: Cast Tornado at cursor, Hurricane persists as body-centered aura; player repositions (Enigma teleport standard) to keep wandering Tornado on-target through packs.

geometry: Tornado synergies: Cyclone Armor, Twister — scaffold
traits_affixes: Hurricane synergy: Tornado, Cyclone Armor — scaffold

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Tornado is physical+magic dual type — physical rule makes it element-neutral; magic-damage component also element-neutral per MW1-close ruling. Hurricane is cold-element water family with chill from slow-on-cold-aura (attested as 'cold damage dealer' and 'crowd control'). Wandering Tornado path = R-M6 drift class. ZONE_CONTROL from Hurricane persistent large-radius aura maintaining battlefield coverage. PERSISTENCE_ENGINE_uptime for Hurricane uptime loop.
